About.title: I care about the whole product, not only the screen.
About.paragraphOne: I am a Computer Science student and Full-Stack Web Developer based in Gaza, Palestine. My main focus is building web applications that connect thoughtful interfaces with reliable backend systems.
About.paragraphTwo: I enjoy working across different parts of a product, from frontend architecture and user experience to APIs, databases, authentication, and practical AI integration.
About.focusDetail: Modern web applications built from interface to backend.
About.approachDetail: Clear interfaces, maintainable code, reliable systems, and intentional technical decisions.
